messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Jeff, I'm sorry. Your B30 did not go out on October 30, and after what I told you last week that's exactly what shouldn't have happened.

Where it actually stands: the batch is in the US now, clearing customs, and due at our Chattanooga warehouse this week. Your unit ships out of there early next week with the Miner Duster and Power Kit in the same box.

You can watch that batch move here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking goes to (email hidden) the moment the label prints.
The month of October has been over and I haven’t received anything in regards to my order
Handed to the team · order is 107 days old and past every date on it; no stock at the warehouse yet

You're right, and I'm not going to dress it up. You ordered in July, the date moved twice, and the unit still isn't out the door. That's on us.

The only thing on the order for the wait so far is the free Power Kit and the Miner Duster added in September. I've put your order in front of the team to confirm a shipping date you can actually hold us to. They're offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email, so you don't need to wait here.
I was already told that I was getting those items for free so you’re not doing anything else here to make up for the lies
Handed to the team · customer wants compensation beyond the goodwill I'm allowed to give

Fair point, Jeff. Those were for the September delay, not for missing October 30 on top of it.

Something more for this is above what I can hand out myself, so I've put it to the team along with the ship date. They're offline tonight and pick it up at 10am ET tomorrow, and you'll get the answer by email, so there's nothing for you to chase.

Your B30 stays yours at the locked price in the meantime.
